card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "To reduce the risk" at the start of a warning sentence, just before the named harm. It also fires on "prevent" in "To prevent pregnancy".

modes.label: The phrase "reduce the risk of"
modes.description: The word "of" after "To reduce the risk" in a sentence that introduces a precaution.
modes.example: To reduce the risk<< of>> respiratory depression, proper dosing and tit

modes.label: The phrase "to prevent"
modes.description: The word "prevent" in a purpose clause that begins with "To" and leads into a precaution.
modes.example: To<< prevent>> pregnancy, females of reproductive potential must use

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to name the harm being avoided, such as a specific adverse event.
card.plain: It responds to the point in a warning sentence where "to reduce the risk of" is about to name the harm.
